notes: Entries preserve the user's complete candidate list. A pending or unresolved status is not a claim that data was acquired or processed.
Native format and version are recorded only where documented in the linked official source; otherwise they are marked unknown and require source metadata before acquisition.
Shard-level counts, hashes, and processing/training counters belong in status.jsonl.
Seven additional public automotive-camera candidates are supplemental to, and do not replace, the 26 designated sources. They remain catalogued_pending until official data are acquired and validated.

Automotive frame manifests should follow vision-frame.schema.json; retain source sequence, timestamp, camera, calibration/pose references, annotation references, dimensions, and split. No automotive frame has been acquired or processed yet.
Current C11 text trainer run is width 128 / vocabulary 1024 (327,936 scalar parameters); this is not a 1.45B-parameter training execution.
